note: Family-owned resort and marina on Corps of Engineers land at Lake Sakakawea's Tobacco Garden Bay, about 26 miles north of Watford City on Hwy 1806. Campsites in north and south sections, plus two cabins, a restaurant, boat ramp and marina. Store and restaurant hours are short midweek in the off-season; call ahead when arriving late. --Claude
summary: Operator site + RezStream read: 50A-only electric (no water/sewer at site), $23 primitive / $27 electric, open year-round, 2-night reservation minimum (3 on holidays), 14-night max, military and senior rates. Google 4.5/344. Lakefront not supported by named sites -> lakeview recommended. Pin ok.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, not --AWH): recommend lakeview. The resort publishes no site map and says 'we can NOT guarantee specific site numbers', so no named nightly site can be shown within ~50 m. Imagery does show two clusters of units on open grass about 25-45 m above the shore: the NW shore bench of the north section (~48.1098,-103.1060, about 4 units) and the west peninsula loop (~48.1048,-103.1095, units ~25-35 m from the bay over grass and low shrub). Most north-section sites sit along the inner loops 80-200 m from the water, and the south section (by the store) faces the marina channel and houses. If a site map turns up naming the shore-bench sites, lakefront could be kept with a caveat naming them.

LONG-STAY: 'Seasonal spots are available by lottery (May 1st – Oct 31st)', but a June 2027 weekday search returned 72 numbered nightly RV units (sites 1-67, A/B) of 'over 100 campsites' (HHS licence: 60 lots), so the nightly share is the large majority. No discouraging wording. Google 4.5 stars / 344 reviews. Passes.
MIN STAY: standing 2-night minimum for reservations (3 on Memorial Day, July 4 and Labor Day): under the 3-night drop line.
PRICE: $27 electric base, under the $50 gate.

HOURS: home page lists the store/office closed Tuesday-Wednesday ('Monday- STORE ONLY 9am-2pm'); 'If you're traveling from a distance, please call ahead to confirm that we are open.' Late arrivals must arrange before the store closes.
OHV: licensed ATVs/golf carts allowed only as transport to the store and in/out of the campground; 'NO Dirt Bikes'. Not an OHV park.
PIN: stored 48.10453,-103.10470 is in the central/store area (Google 48.10504,-103.10478, ~57 m): ok.
PHONE 701-842-4199 and WEBSITE https://tobaccogardens.com/ confirmed. HHS licence holder P.S. Hellendsaas Enterprises Inc.; ownership private stands.

HORSES (AWH rule 2026-11-12): the Tobacco Gardens camping, policy and amenities pages and the RezStream page are silent on horses; imagery shows no corrals or horse pens. Not a horse campground; keep.
